learned: 2026-10-05, by an agent pass: the brand's COA list (DANK_COA_UPDATED 2026-09-26), 1729 lab-batch rows; 640 tested in the last year, which make 482 entries. 2026-10-08, curation pass: plain-category 1.1g joints, 1.35g blunts and 5-packs are infused (package photos, Weedmaps); DANK-31625 7-packs are 7 x 1g; SAMPLE row skipped; three strain spellings fixed.
notes: The only machine-readable catalog is the /coa page's data file, window.DANK_COA_ROWS = [[category, subcategory, product, batch, coa_url, tested, thc, is_new, lab_sample_id], ...]. Category is FLOWER, PRE-ROLLS or INFUSED PRE-ROLLS; subcategory is size and format ('3.5 GRAM BAGS', '.5 GRAM JOINTS', '1.25 GRAM BLUNTS', '7 PACK PRE-ROLLS'); product is the strain in capitals. One row per batch: repeats collapse to one entry per product and size, and id is the strain so an entry's id does not change with which batch comes first.

INFUSED PRE-ROLLS take the line Infused: 29 strain and size pairs exist both infused and plain. Bag and jar of one strain and size, and a joint and blunt of one strain and size, are one entry (packaging is not part of identity).
The data file is renamed on every upload (/s/<timestamp>_dank-coa-master.js); `discover` reads the current name from the /coa page's DATA_SCRIPT_URLS each run.

The /coa page hides undated batches and batches tested more than 365 days ago (HIDE_AFTER_DAYS); the skip rule's older_than does the same, rolling with the date. Girl Scout Cookies 3.5g (last tested 2025-07-24) is still at two stores, so it comes from the stores' consensus as old stock.

Pack rows give the count but not the unit weight. Most 7 PACK PRE-ROLLS are 7 x 0.5g = 3.5g: the jar prints '7 PK 0.5g JOINTS 3.5Gs' (G13, Skywalker OG photos at NY stores), older batch ids say so ('DANK-26024-PRE-3.5G-GSC') and NY stores list them at 3.5g. Batch DANK-31625-* (Blue Dream, Cap Junky, Gary Payton, OG Kush, Sour Tangie) is the 7 x 1g pack: Blue Dream's jar prints '7 PK 1g JOINTS 7-1G Joints Net Weight 7g', Weedmaps lists 'Sour Tangie | Joints | 1g each | 7pk' and 'Gary Payton | Joints | 1g each | 7pk' at $60-79 against $40 for a 0.5g 7-pack, and Dank's own store lists Blue Dream and OG Kush 7-packs at 7g. The site does not tell the two apart, so a new 7 x 1g batch under another batch code reads as 3.5g until a rule names it.

5 PACK PREROLLS are the Infused 5-pack whichever category the site files them in: the jar prints 'INFUSED JOINTS 5 PK 0.5g JOINTS 2.5Gs INDOOR CANNABIS FLOWER + 250MGs CONCENTRATE NET WT. 2.75Gs' (Blueberry Diesel, Sour Sorbet, Dank N Donuts, filed under PRE-ROLLS; Hawaiian Thunderfuck, Blue Dream under INFUSED PRE-ROLLS). Plain 14-packs have no unit weight on the site and none at stores, so they are skipped.

PRE-ROLLS '1.1 GRAM JOINTS' and '1.35 GRAM BLUNTS' are infused (1g + 100mg concentrate; 1.25g blunt + 100mg concentrate): Creme Brulee's tube prints 'INFUSED JOINT 1.1G, 1G INDOOR CANNABIS FLOWER + 100MGs CONCENTRATE', Weedmaps lists 'Lychee | Infused Joint | 1.1g' and 'Pineapple Express | Infused Blunt | 1.35g' ('infused with 100MG of concentrate'), and both test 33-35% THC median against 27% for plain joints and blunts. They take the line Infused.
The row named SAMPLE (INFUSED PRE-ROLLS .5 GRAM JOINTS, batch DANK-26219-TT) is a lab sample, not a product.

Flower 'GORILLA GLUE #4' (3.5g bag, 2026) is the same strain and size as 'GORILLA GLUE' (3.5g jar): Gorilla Glue #4 is the strain's full name ('Original Glue'), and Dank's own store describes its 'GORILLA GLUE' 3.5g as 'also called Original Glue'. It takes the catalog's spelling Gorilla Glue; the infused 1g keeps the site's GG4.

skip.why: batch tested over a year ago, or undated (the /coa page hides these)
a lab sample row, not a product
plain 14-packs: no unit weight on the site or at stores
